description: SWS Building Electric Demand Profile is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Cameron Dolan (Alaska Center for Energy and Power, University of Alaska Fairbanks). This dataset contains data on the electric use of the building in 15-minute increments (kilowatt-hours and average kilowatts). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
